optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Plant Procurement Manager, Industrial Gas Supply Network
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided materials establish seven years of plant procurement experience, roles as buyer and risk process operator, support for capital equipment tenders, procurement boundary documentation, and audit findings closure. They do not establish eight years of experience, leadership of a procurement team, or that the candidate personally ran capital equipment tenders above the group’s delegated limit.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess evidence gaps and interview signals.

role.roleTitle: Plant Procurement Manager, Industrial Gas Supply Network

evidence.text: Five years in plant procurement at a regional cement producer, the last two as the buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy, reporting to the plant procurement team leader.
evidence.notes: Shows five years at cement producer but not total years or team leadership

missingEvidence: Need documented evidence of eight total years in plant or heavy‑industry procurement and at least three years running a plant procurement team

evidence.text: Supported the capital equipment tenders run by the team leader for the kiln refurbishment, preparing the tender documents and the bid comparison; the tender board submissions were made by the team leader.
evidence.notes: Shows support but not that candidate ran the tender or that it was above delegated limit

missingEvidence: Need evidence that the candidate personally ran a capital equipment tender above the group’s delegated limit and that it was presented to the tender board

evidence.text: Operated the supplier risk process for the three plants' critical parts, keeping the critical supplier register and the quarterly risk review with the plant maintenance managers.
evidence.notes: Directly demonstrates documented supplier risk process

evidence.text: Five years in plant procurement at a regional cement producer, the last two as the buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under the group procurement policy, reporting to the plant procurement team leader.
evidence.notes: Shows buyer role for maintenance parts and contracted services

evidence.text: Wrote the annual procurement boundary note for each of the three plants and closed the two internal audit findings raised against the plants' purchase order controls in 2024.
evidence.notes: Directly demonstrates procurement boundaries and audit findings closure
